questions.question: In a certain code language, 'GINGER' is coded as '30 - 30' and 'RADISH' is coded as '23 - 36'. How will 'TOMATO' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of first three letters of given word - Sum of last three letter of given word.**

'GINGER' is coded as '30 - 30'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1830cc674016bb67c29dd1684b4aaa584d454fb0d1d8b77badd1b3bfd63bd485.png] 

= (7 + 9 + 14) - (7 + 5 + 18)

= 30 - 30

And

'RADISH' is coded as '23 - 36'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7e544fcce991e84f9af380bff57f41307cd8f0548b4cb5d0e298c5e573792e.png] 

= (18 + 1 + 4) - (9 + 19 + 8)

= 23 - 36

Similarly,

'TOMATO' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a49e62ad621c0c39fb5a426e95ff5f27b1a1d4cc500d9d31ea744ef411fb836.png] 

**= (20 + 15 + 13) - (1 + 20 + 15)**

**= 48 - 36**

Hence, the correct answer is **"48 - 36".**

questions.question: In a row of 40 boys facing the North, Amar is 6th to the right of Sandeep and Sandeep is 11th to the left of Vijay. If Amar is 28th from the right end of the row, what is the position of Vijay from the left end of row?
questions.solution:
Given data :

1) All are facing the north. Amar is 6th to the right of Sandeep and Sandeep is 11th to the left of Vijay.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6678e4dbda9a0916001b4c2aec5ff51176beca598f0ef1b37aea06714a1b0281.png] 

 

2) If Amar is 28th from the right end of the row then Vijay is 23rd from the right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/429252502e20c3cdddf6ceee438763746f8ba1e9c32d020dce23e8dbbd039fb4.png] 

Position of Vijay from the left end of row = Total numbers of boys + 1 - Position of Vijay from the right end of the row.

= 40 + 1 - 23 

= 18

Position of Vijay from the left end of the row is -18th 

Hence, '18th' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
86 is related to 298 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 105 is related to 317. To which of the following is 48 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting /multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 212) = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 86 : 298

⇒ 86 + 212 = 298.

For, 105 : 317

⇒ 105 + 212 = 317.

Similarly, for 48 ∶ ?

**⇒ 48 + 212 = 260.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: If 9 × 6 = 45, 7 × 4 = 33 and 6 × 4 = 20, then what is the value of 5 × 3?
questions.solution:
The logic here is as follows,

9² – 6² = 81 – 36 = 45

7² – 4² = 49 – 16 = 33

6² – 4² = 36 – 16 = 20

Similarly,

5² – 3² = 25 – 9 = 16

Thus, the value of 5 × 3 = 16.

questions.question: A tree has nine branches and on each branch there are nine nests. Each nest having nine birds and each bird needs nine grains to be fed. How many grains are needed?
questions.solution:
According to the question,

A tree has 9 branches and on each branch, there are 9 Nests.

Total Nest = 9 × 9 = 81

Each nest have 9 birds.

Total birds = 81 × 9 = 729

Each bird needs 9 grains to be fed.

Total grains are = 729 × 9 = 6561

Hence, **Option (3)** is correct.
